scope: The current fourteen product model theories are received from their unchanged source bytes in one retained captured-source parent lineage. All 353 explicitly named model roots are checked for transitive oracle dependencies with skip_proofs=false. The runtime_link assumptions in the end-to-end model remain assumptions.
identityBoundary: Existing implementation, ABI, compiled runtime, model declarations, locales and assumptions are preserved. Model-source reception does not establish runtime-to-model correspondence.
reproductionBoundary: Full mode rehashes retained source, database, heap lineage, source-specific oracle guards and current input snapshots. Metadata-only mode checks the immutable public record and current model bindings. Neither mode is a fresh kernel replay or independent Assurance. The retained artifact bundle and locator are required for full mode.
rootAuditBoundary: The admitted inventory is the complete explicitly named model-root set. Generated auxiliary prover facts are not admitted by a blanket name exemption and are not claimed as an all-global-fact audit.
